name: advent-of-code
description: My advent of code contributions from 2020 onwards.

scripts.format:csharp: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.csproj' | xargs --null --max-procs=4 --replace={} sh -c 'cd "${1%/*}" && dotnet format --verbosity quiet' _ {}
scripts.format:fsharp: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.fsproj' | xargs --null --max-procs=4 --replace={} sh -c 'cd "${1%/*}" && dotnet fantomas --json . > /dev/null' _ {}
scripts.format:rust: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*/Cargo.toml' | xargs --null --max-procs=4 --replace={} sh -c 'cd "${1%/*}" && cargo fmt' _ {}
scripts.format: run-p --silent format:js format:csharp format:fsharp format:rust format:ruby format:haskell format:python
scripts.lint: run-p --silent lint:js lint:python lint:rust lint:ruby lint:haskell lint:csharp lint:fsharp
scripts.lint:rust: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*/Cargo.toml' | xargs --null --max-procs=4 --replace={} sh -c 'cd "${1%/*}" && cargo fmt --check' _ {}
scripts.lint:csharp: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.csproj' | xargs --null --max-procs=4 --replace={} sh -c 'cd "${1%/*}" && dotnet format --verify-no-changes --verbosity quiet' _ {}
scripts.lint:fsharp: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.fsproj' | xargs --null --max-procs=4 --replace={} sh -c 'cd "${1%/*}" && dotnet fantomas check .' _ {}
